decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer builds directly on the firm's core inkjet and ink expertise, and its in-house R&D can keep refining it, so it remains a natural part of the portfolio.
The numbering software module extends the firm's variable-data printing software and fits its serialization strategy, so it can be maintained cheaply with existing knowledge.
Coding on non-absorbent surfaces draws on the firm's ink chemistry know-how, so it can absorb customer feedback and improve the product for demanding industrial applications.

The CodeScan app is the successor to PharmaScan and supports the firm's traceability strategy, but mobile apps lie somewhat further from its hardware core and are often replaced, so the drop risk is moderate.
Inline code verification complements the firm's coding systems and fits its digitalization and traceability direction, where its existing knowledge lets it apply and improve the product.
Layout design software provides common operation across the firm's printers and builds on its in-house software expertise, making it a core enabler worth retaining.
